images.note: Real Snowsight screenshot from Snowflake's own official 'Getting Started with Snowflake' Quickstart guide. The guide's own text for this exact image says: 'navigate to the Query History tab by clicking the Home icon and then Activity > Query History. Select the query at the top of the list... Select the Query Profile tab and note the steps taken by the query to execute, query details, most expensive nodes, and additional statistics' — this is literally Snowsight's Query History / Query Profile view after a load, the same screen this lesson teaches as the first troubleshooting stop.
